When an enemy is downed on the ground but not dead, you can CAPTURE them.

To capture, select a colonist, right-click on the incapacitated enemy, and select Cap

The HOME AREA tells your colonists which area to clean and where to extinguish fires.

Define the HOME AREA with the Zones category under the Architect menu.

Drugs can be useful, but can also lead to harmful addictions.

If you want to avoid drugs in your colony, you have the option of burning them at a campfire.

To rescue a wounded person, select a healthy colonist and then right-click on the wounded one.
